hero.title: Become a Partner
hero.lede: Work with a Dubai-based team with more than 10 years in citizenship and residency by investment. You introduce the client; we handle the file from start to finish and keep you informed.

items.d: Offer your clients more programmes, backed by an experienced case team in Dubai.
Law and accounting firms, real estate and travel agencies: add second citizenship and residency to the services you offer.
Know people looking for a second passport or residency? Introduce them and we take it from there.
One contact person for all your referrals and questions.
Documents, background checks and government submission handled by our team.
You are kept informed at every stage, with your client's consent.
Regular briefings on programme changes, so you can advise with confidence.
Programme overviews you can share with your clients.
Meet our team in person whenever you or your clients are in Dubai.
Fill in the short form below. It takes about two minutes.
We review your application and get to know your business.
Terms and commission are agreed in a written agreement.
Introduce clients. We manage the file and keep you updated.

form.title: Partnership application
form.sub: Tell us a little about you. Our partnerships team will contact you after reviewing your application.
form.name: Full name
form.volume: Clients you could refer per year
form.source: How did you hear about us?
form.consent: I agree that Sharif Group may contact me about this application.
form.privacy: Your details are used only to review your application and contact you. They are never shared with anyone else.
form.errType: Please choose how you are applying.
form.errPhone: Please enter a valid WhatsApp number.
form.errEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
form.errWeb: Please enter a valid website or LinkedIn link.
form.errConsent: Please confirm that we may contact you.

note.title: Good to know
items: Joining is free. There is no fee to become a partner.
Commission terms are shared after review, in a written agreement.
Partners act as independent introducers. They may not present themselves as government-authorised agents or promise approvals, timelines or results.
Every partner and referred client goes through our due-diligence checks.

items.q: Is there a cost to become a partner?
items.a: No. Joining the partnership programme is free.
Commission terms are agreed in a written partnership agreement after we review your application.
It depends on your country and type of business. We review every application individually, and individual introducers are welcome.

items.q: Do I keep the relationship with my client?
items.a: Yes. You stay in contact with your client and receive updates on the case, with the client's consent.

items.q: Which countries do you work with?
items.a: We work with partners in many countries, subject to our due-diligence checks.

thanks.title: Thank you, {name}!
thanks.text: We have received your partnership application. Here is what happens next.
thanks.already: We already have an application with this email address. Our team will be in touch.

steps.d: Our partnerships team reviews your application.
We contact you on WhatsApp or by email to arrange a call.
If it's a good fit, we share the partnership agreement and terms.
